body:
## Outcome and dependencies
Implement the **normal Work Unit disposition / strict V1 success** boundary using the current final SemanticAcceptance and complete custody already retained by P3. Do not implement another final assessor, assurance protocol or semantic-admission hop.

**Depends on:** #22, and therefore #21, #20 / G3-V1 PASS, #16 / G2-V1 PASS and #11 / G1-V1 PASS. This implementation order permits integrated replacement/finalization race tests; a normal successful Work Unit does **not** have to abandon or retry first. **Feeds:** the separate G4-V1 review.

## Governing basis and existing seams
Apply the current [target v0.5](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/docs/governing/broodling-target-responsibility-boundary-design-v0.5.md), especially §§5.3, 6, 8.4 and 10, before [plan v0.5](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/docs/governing/broodling-implementation-dependency-plan-v0.5.md) §§5.6–5.7 and 7 / V1-P4 / G4-V1. Then use [G1-V1](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/qualification/v1-p1/issue-11-g1-v1.md), especially W6/W7, current P2/P3 implementation and #16/#20.

**Inspected baseline:** `main` at `8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124`. Reuse `FinalAssuranceCoordinator`, the immutable `final_assurance` row, the public normal-run observation in `ZeroshotSubmitter`, and the current P3 graph. P3 retains Contract/Attempt/run, final occurrence, latest graph mutation occurrence, declared exact candidate/B1 material, raw evidence and criterion rationale. That is SemanticAcceptance/custody, **not Work Unit disposition**. Candidate generation is structurally represented by runtime mutation provenance, not a model ordinal or content seal.

[W6's normal-result and interruption evidence](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/259a64aa7c06602b6f0fd49fe6af064097211046/qualification/v1-p1/issue-10-w4-w6.md) is the reference mechanism. Use the current G3-reviewed product rather than restoring an older qualification graph.

## Implementation and discriminating acceptance criteria
- [ ] Add the smallest durable disposition record and normal finalization operation. Bind the Work Unit, applicable immutable Contract, current Attempt/run, designated final occurrence, final structural candidate state and complete retained justification. Reference existing immutable P3 custody rather than duplicating a runtime ledger or generic result archive.
- [ ] Record `SUCCEEDED` only from **current applicable final SemanticAcceptance**, complete required custody, and the same admitted Contract's **explicitly empty required-effect set**. The general completed-and-verified required-effect terms are vacuously satisfied, not waived. Missing/unsupported effect declarations cannot be defaulted to empty; preserve no-effect admission and never execute optional effects or GitDelivery.
- [ ] Check currentness/non-abandonment transactionally with the disposition write and #21's abandonment boundary. The final authority must concern the last graph-authorized candidate generation with no subsequent mutation, using P3's qualified structural provenance. A1's historical acceptance, ordinary/lookalike output, a model-supplied identifier, clean review/adjudication or bare runtime success cannot establish this.
- [ ] Retain all Contract-required final candidate/comparison material, raw evidence/context and criterion-level rationale before success. Missing required material, unresolved obligations or a semantic gap cannot become success. Do not infer new material-selection semantics for an older Contract or re-judge model semantics in a second generic validator.
- [ ] Keep minimal durable non-success/abandonment reasons and last trustworthy diagnostic references where completion is unavailable; do not introduce a full outcome taxonomy, semantic recovery state machine or automatic follow-up work.
- [ ] Duplicate/concurrent normal finalization and lost acknowledgements return one identical committed disposition. Conflicting identity/justification cannot overwrite it. Race stop against finalization: abandonment winning the durable boundary prevents success; a complete disposition already committed remains readable and is not retroactively replaced by a late stop or retry. Stop itself never produces success.
- [ ] Inject interruption after final runtime output, during P3 custody capture, **after complete P3 custody but before disposition**, and immediately before/after disposition commit. On restart, either a complete durable disposition already exists and is read back, or the Attempt is abandoned through #21. Retained P3 assurance alone is not permission to salvage interrupted finalization into success. No completed-run scan, semantic catch-up, late eligibility restoration or resumed final-assessor computation.
- [ ] After completed disposition, demonstrate reading its full justification without live provider sessions/runtime observation or the disposable worktree. Use controlled fixture cleanup to verify custody durability; this does not require a new general successful-worktree cleanup policy. Missing material before completion blocks success; cleanup cannot remove the only justification for an already completed result.
- [ ] Integrate #21/#22 races: a delayed A1 final result or capture after A2 becomes current cannot complete A1, overwrite A2's acceptance/disposition or import old semantic state. Repeated stop/retry/finalize requests remain scoped to their intended Attempt and cannot create competing authority.

## Required G4 real-provider vertical slice
- [ ] Retain a bounded **actual product** no-effect Work Unit using the qualified real provider through the official SDK/sidecar. It must include a substantive Contract-backed directive and **real repair**, renewed required evidence, fresh independent review, eligible resolution, current final semantic assessment and durable justified disposition. A clean-only run or controlled model-role substitutes do not establish the required real repair path. The existing deterministic graph-local evidence leaf remains appropriate.
- [ ] Record exact admitted Contract/B1, product graph/runtime/profile/build, actual run/occurrence references, observed correction and final retained material. Keep deterministic crash/race controls separately identified. This is a finite integration witness, not P5's semantic-quality corpus, threshold-setting or prompt/model optimization campaign. Any relevant profile change requires affected W5/W6/W7 and current assurance controls rather than assumed equivalence.

## Stop boundary
Commit the implementation, discriminating tests and new P4 evidence; preserve all prior governing, qualification and gate records unchanged. No public CLI/service/product-interface work or broad semantic evaluation. No effects/publication/reconciliation, cross-Attempt reuse, completed-occurrence recovery, candidate sealing/provenance, scheduler, session manager, second runtime ledger/router/validator or release claim. Stop at the normal justified no-effect disposition boundary and its G4 evidence.
title: [V1-P4] Record normal no-effect Work Unit disposition from current final assurance
